prompts.perch: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset: a matched RAW AND GRILLED river perch pair for Cozy Farm's Lavender Bay tactile fish kitchen. Generate one transparent image with exactly TWO horizontal isolated fish, raw fish in upper half, cooked fish in lower half, fully separated by generous clear transparent space. Reference 1 is the approved sea bass skin: match its cuisine illustration, surface detail, 40-degree view of a whole prepared fish lying on its side, adult edible proportions and readable width. Reference 2 gives ONLY the species palette and recognizable fins; do NOT reproduce that reference's cute live-swimming cartoon, glows, square framing or broken transparency. Subject: sage green and warm silver body with recognizable soft lavender vertical stripes, apricot orange dorsal and tail fins. Head LEFT, tail RIGHT, closed mouth, cleanly prepared fish, four clean diagonal shallow preparation cuts in the flesh. Upper fish is raw, moist silvery skin with natural species hue. Lower fish is exactly the SAME fish, same pose, size, silhouette, fin placement, eye, cuts, camera and lighting; change only surface to delicious softly golden-brown cooked skin, toasted fins and warm browned cuts, retaining the species identity. No size differences between upper and lower fish. Each fish fills about 90 percent of image width, silhouette overall approximately 2.5:1, viewed on a kitchen board from above at 40 degrees, not a swimming side-view icon. Entire fish fully visible, flat attached fins, no separate extra items. Warm broad light from upper left, soft cool lavender fill. True alpha zero everywhere outside each fish, including row gap and all four corners. NO floor, plate, board, shadow beneath, text, grid, panel, glow, background, labels, extra food or utensils. Beautiful cohesive hand painted culinary game realism like the approved fish, not a mascot. The two rows must be suitable for identically registered raw/cooked texture blending.
